bio.text: Andrew Hevesi has represented the 28th Assembly District, which includes Forest Hills, Rego Park and Ridgewood, since he was first elected on May 10, 2005.
He was appointed chair of the Assembly Committee on Children and Families in 2021, after chairing the Social Services Committee from 2015 to 2020.

He has a B.A. in political science from Queens College, previously worked as chief of staff to an Assembly member and in the Queens County District Attorney's Domestic Violence Bureau, and lives in Forest Hills.
